titre: Research on the UN + essay (Russia / Ukraine)
description: Le Secrétaire général, l'organisation, ses missions et ses limites ; arguments pour l'essai sur la guerre en Ukraine.

questions.question: Who has been UN Secretary-General since 2017?
questions.explication: António Guterres, ancien Premier ministre portugais ; son second mandat s'achève le 31 décembre 2026 (successeur à partir du 1er janvier 2027).

questions.question: What is the Secretary-General's mission? (plusieurs réponses)
choix: head of the Secretariat, the UN's chief administrative officer
bringing to the Security Council's attention any threat to peace
using his « good offices » to mediate in conflicts
being the spokesperson of the UN
questions.explication: Article 97-99 de la Charte : chef de l'administration, médiation, alerte du Conseil, porte-parole.

questions.question: Where is UN headquarters?
questions.explication: Siège à New York ; autres sièges : Genève, Vienne, Nairobi.

questions.question: When is UN Day (the Charter came into force)?
questions.explication: Charte signée le 26 juin 1945 à San Francisco, en vigueur le 24 octobre 1945.

questions.question: What types of missions does the UN carry out? (plusieurs réponses)
questions.explication: Les grands domaines d'action de l'ONU.

questions.question: What are the objectives of the UN (Charter, Article 1)? (plusieurs réponses)
choix: to achieve international cooperation on economic, social and humanitarian problems
to promote respect for human rights
to defend the interests of the P5
to develop friendly relations among nations
to maintain international peace and security

questions.question: What limits the UN's action? (plusieurs réponses)
choix: it depends on member states' funding
it has no army of its own
the veto of the five permanent members
it can impose taxes on citizens
General Assembly resolutions are not binding

questions.question: What happened to the Security Council draft resolution condemning Russia's invasion of Ukraine (February 25, 2022)?
On March 2, 2022, how many states voted in the General Assembly to demand Russia's withdrawal from Ukraine?
questions.explication: Résolution ES-11/1 : 141 pour, 5 contre, 35 abstentions — mais non contraignante.

questions.question: What was the Black Sea Grain Initiative (July 2022)?
choix: a deal brokered by the UN and Türkiye to let Ukrainian grain be exported
questions.explication: Accord sur les céréales, abandonné par la Russie en juillet 2023.

questions.question: What did the International Court of Justice order on March 16, 2022?
choix: that Russia immediately suspend its military operations in Ukraine
questions.explication: Ordonnance non respectée par la Russie.

questions.question: From which UN body was Russia suspended in April 2022?
Essay: Does the existence of the UN make a difference in the Russia–Ukraine conflict? (plan)
questions.verso: LIMITS: Russia, a P5 member, vetoes any Security Council action; GA resolutions (141 votes, March 2022) are not binding; the ICJ order was ignored. BUT: the UN isolated Russia diplomatically (GA votes, suspension from the Human Rights Council), brokered the Black Sea Grain Initiative (2022-2023), sends humanitarian aid, IAEA inspectors at Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant, documents human rights violations. → It makes a difference for civilians, not for ending the war.
